description: This file provides utility functions for serving files and streams over HTTP, including setting appropriate headers based on content type and download preferences, specifically for the Mattermost server platform.

methods.name: WriteFileResponse
methods.description: Serves a file to HTTP response, setting headers and handling content length and last modification time.

methods.name: WriteStreamResponse
methods.description: Streams data from an io.Reader to HTTP response, setting headers appropriately.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Configures HTTP headers for content type, disposition, caching, and security based on parameters.
